title: Feature card · image left + copy
description: Mirror of BOD-02. On mobile the photo stacks above the copy.
usage: Feature card on a grey panel. Short benefit headline + 2–3 lines of copy; the photo carries the proof. Locked layout — edit only image fills and text.

images.notes: JPG, cover. Left corners rounded 8px inline.
JPG, cover crop of the same photo. Shown above the copy on mobile; top corners rounded 8px inline.

notes: Columns stack on mobile with mfs-stack; source order already puts the photo first, so no dir="rtl" trick is needed.

The photo changes aspect ratio on mobile (276x250 to full-width x 150), so the module ships two crops: the desktop image has mfs-hide and the mobile crop has mfs-show. Replace both when swapping the photo.
Heading uses mfs-h2 per CONVENTIONS (28 → 24 on mobile); the Figma Mobile frame keeps 28px.
